plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Kinesiology AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8045/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 60-62; lower bound 60 encoded = 15+14+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 STAT C1000E/PSYC 330 -> 3; Sem 2 CHEM 305/PHYS 350 -> 4). STATISTICS CHOICE: STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics (4 units) or PSYC 330 Introductory Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences (3 units); both require Intermediate Algebra or equivalent (placement; documented here, not encoded). Lower bound 3 encoded. SCIENCE CHOICE: CHEM 305 Introduction to Chemistry (5 units; requires Elementary Algebra or higher; recommended) or PHYS 350 General Physics (4 units; pre-req MATH 335 — not sequenced, documented here). Lower bound 4 encoded. BIOL 430 pre-req per map: CHEM 305, 309 or 400; encoded as one_of (CHEM 305/309/400 carried under external_prereqs because CHEM 305 appears only as a choice-slot option and CHEM 309/400 are not sequenced). List A (minimum 3 units; 1 unit sequenced in each of Semesters 2, 3, and 4): activity courses including FITNS 380, 381 (0.5-1), 390, 406, 440, 306, 320, 324, 326, 328, 348, 352, 384, 393, 401 (0.5-1), 407 (0.5-1), 441 (comfort in shallow water required), Core Conditioning II: Fitness Ball, PACT 310, 311, 381, 390, 391, 430, 431, Soccer - Outdoor, Outdoor Soccer II, TMACT 300, 301, 320, 321, 330, 331. Option arrays capped at 10 entries; full list documented here. A different List A course per slot. CalGETC Area 4: a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines is required (one 3-unit Area 4 course in each of Semesters 3 and 4; Semester 3 suggestion: KINES 308 Women in Sport). Semester 4 Area 3A suggestion: DANCE 386 Dance History. Transferable electives: units needed to total 60 for graduation; Semester 1 suggestion: HEED 300 Health Science or NUTRI 300 Nutrition. This map also meets the AA degree in Physical Education (no separate sequence published). CalGETC Area 1A: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
